name: pbx-ladder
notes: The validated PBX ladder: name and DOB spoken, the order number keyed in where the PBX asks for DTMF, then the screening questions. Turn-for-turn the same script as loadtest/scenarios/jane/default.json's pbx-parity, so an audio run and a text run are comparable. Runs past the screening questions and ends in Jane's understanding-error transfer, which is the deterministic baseline.
